sources.accessNote: status=waf-blocked — the host answers automated clients with a WAF rejection page carrying HTTP 200. The crawler detects and reports this rather than recording it; getting real access is a Section 2.6 institutional matter, not a crawler setting.
sources.notes: National public-service information portal; the closest existing analogue to SuperAsk's corpus and a priority acquisition target. Homepage observed 2026-09-07; ownership from site banner (Ministry of Civil Service + Council for Administrative Reform). NOT CRAWLABLE: WAF rejects automated fetches and returns HTTP 200 with a 266-byte 'Request Rejected' page, so status code alone is misleading (FR-48); robots.txt also blocked, so NFR-15 delays cannot be read; TLS certificate CN=www.preyveng.gov.kh. Obtain access via the owning institution (Mode B, section 2.6).
